description: Claim a phase of an item as finished, with the commit it was finished at: phase build is the claim-done (Done is then offered to Andy, who alone presses it); phase red claims a code item's red. commit is 7 to 40 lower-case hex characters, pushed first; it may be empty only for a plain item's build claim, which has no code. An agent claims done only with ALL of its own testicle green (goal/G47.1).
